messages:
release-bot: Build finished: private-installer v1.8.0-airgap ✅
release-bot: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-releases/private/v1.8.0-airgap.tar.gz
release-bot: cosign signature created with key id ABCD1234 (expires 2026-04-02T00:00Z)
Maria: heads-up: that cosign key expires in ~11 days. some customers (gov/pci) validate expiry strictly, we must rotate before GA push. :eyes:
Devon: can we re-sign the existing tarball with a new key, or do we need a full rebuild?
Sam: you can re-sign the tarball without rebuilding. cosign sign-blob/attach works on the artifact. but we need the new private key available (KMS/HSM).
Maria: if we re-sign, we need to update checksums and release notes and ensure customers can verify both keys during transition. also pin image digests in the release manifest.
ops-oncall: Key status: the new signing key material is being provisioned in KMS (project redwood-sec). Rotation requires an issuance window and manual enrollment for offline customers. propose maintenance window: 2026-04-01 22:00-23:00 UTC.
Josh: timeline OK. two questions: 1) will re-signing change artifact names or tags? 2) rollback procedure if verification fails for customers?
Sam: 1) re-signing doesn't change tarball digest if you sign external blob, but cosign attaches a signature that might be sidecar. recommend keeping same artifact path and publish new .sig and updated sha256.txt. 2) rollback: repoint release index to previous digest and revoke new signature in transparency log — we'll document runbook.
Maria: propose we: (a) pause GA cut until after rotation, (b) perform canary re-sign + internal verification, (c) publish updated checksums + release notes linking to new key fingerprint.
Devon: agree. canary idea: re-sign and push to staging customers (dedicated pool) at 22:15 UTC, monitor verification errors and install logs for 30m.
release-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary-re-sign-staging @ 2026-04-01T22:15:00Z -> status pending
Sam: command to re-sign (ops will run):
```
# sign using KMS-backed key
cosign sign-blob --key kms://projects/redwood-sec/locations/global/keyRings/releases/cryptoKeys/airgap-sign v1.8.0-airgap.tar.gz > v1.8.0-airgap.tar.gz.sig
# verify locally
cosign verify-blob --key <pubkey.pem> --signature v1.8.0-airgap.tar.gz.sig v1.8.0-airgap.tar.gz
```
ops-oncall: ops will own rotation steps. I'll create a staged runbook and post link. oncall for window: @ops-oncall (me) + Sam + Maria.
Josh: release notes checklist: bump release date, note re-signing and new key fingerprint, include migration steps for offline customers and expected verification behaviour. also add support contact for urgent fails.
Maria: final ask: add automated post-release check that verifies cosign signatures across our mirror locations (s3, gcs, onprem CDN). small script: fetch artifact, run cosign verify-blob against both old and new pubkeys and report mismatches.
Devon: will add the check to post-release CI pipeline (quick job).
release-bot: After canary completes, will post status. If canary passes, schedule GA push at 2026-04-02 00:30 UTC (outside business hours).
Maria: ack. please ensure release notes include explicit SHA256 digest and tag-by-digest instructions for customers: `docker pull <registry>@sha256:<digest>` and reference old digest for fallback. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: created draft runbook: https://docs.internal/releases/airgap-rotation-runbook (will fill details).
Sam: I'll prepare cosign pubkeys and add to release artifacts repo.
release-bot: Canary started (22:15 UTC) -> Pod logs forwarded to #eng-releases-canary.
Devon: watching logs. initial verification OK for first 3 installs.
Maria: thanks team — I'll sign off on GA once canary completes and oncall gives green.
ops-oncall: last check: any customers with pinned signatures? if so we'll need to coordinate direct notify.
Josh: we have 4 customers with pinned sig verification; reaching out now.
release-bot: canary completed (22:45 UTC) -> no verification failures observed in staging (30m).
Maria: green from me to proceed with GA window.
release-bot: GA deploy scheduled for 2026-04-02 00:30 UTC. artifacts re-signed with new key id EFGH5678. old key ABCD1234 revoked in transparency log.
Sam: pushed updated sha256.txt and pubkeys to artifacts.
Devon: pipeline added post-release signature verification job.
Maria: closing thread — thanks. will send release-notes PR and customer comms.
